ci_followup.observed_assertion: Expected Stopping; observed Stopped before actual creation storage work had been submitted.
ci_followup.root_cause: The old test synchronized on acceptance only. Force could legitimately stop the accepted owner before its first poll submitted storage work.
ci_followup.fix: Reuse the existing creation-save gate to wait for actual queued save before Force, then wait for shutdown idle and retain stronger pending/root-lease/final-save assertions.
ci_followup.repeat_method: 100 independent compiled test processes, each selecting the previously failing case by --exact, with four concurrent workers; no retry of failures.
ci_followup.independent_review: Provider contributor independently checked the test diff, creation/shutdown owners and existing gate semantics; no blocking finding.
ci_followup.native_outcome: Follow the CI run attached to the follow-up dev publication; the initial failure is not treated as success.
